message: My car MH02AB1234 was hit from behind near Bandra station on 2026-10-28. The rear bumper and boot are damaged. Nobody was injured. Estimated repair cost is Rs 45000. Policy number POL-MH-10021. No police report filed.

Accident near Andheri East yesterday. My insured vehicle MH03CD4567 collided with a bike. The biker has a fractured arm and was taken to hospital. Policy POL-22018. Police complaint registered. Repair estimate around 78000.

Someone stole my car MH01EF7890 from the parking lot outside my office in Powai last night. Policy no. P-77821. I have informed the police and filed an FIR. No injuries. I don't know the loss amount yet.

My vehicle was completely burnt in a fire at our warehouse in Thane on 2026-10-25. The insurer's surveyor says it is beyond repair. Nobody was hurt. Estimated loss Rs 650000. Registration MH04GH1122, policy POL-9087.

A stone hit my windshield while driving on the Mumbai-Pune Expressway on 2026-10-29. Only the front glass is cracked. Car MH12JK3344. Policy POL-GLASS-18. Glass replacement estimate Rs 12000. No one injured.
Hi team, can you tell me how to renew my motor insurance policy? It expires next month. Policy number POL-55442. Thanks.

Bhai meri car MH02LM5566 ko parking mein kisi ne scratch kar diya. Location: Vashi sector 17. Date 30 October 2026. Policy P-88102. No injury, just scratches. Garage says approx 8500 rupees. Police ko inform nahi kiya.

From: Claims Desk
Subject: Vehicle accident

Dear Team, my insured car MH05NP6677 was involved in an accident at Nashik Road on 2026-10-20. Another vehicle was damaged and its driver suffered minor injuries. Policy number POL-33901. Estimated third-party damage is INR 32000. FIR has been registered.
My car MH14QR8899 is missing from the apartment parking in Pune. I came back and it was not there. Policy POL-66012. I have not checked with security or the police yet. Please advise.

The car MH01ST2233 met with a severe collision on 2026-10-18 near Dadar. The front section is completely crushed and the workshop has declared it beyond economical repair. Nobody was injured. Policy POL-11220. Loss estimate Rs 520000.

My rear windshield got shattered by a falling branch in our building compound at Chembur on 2026-10-27. Registration MH02UV4455. Policy number POL-GL-091. Replacement estimate 16000. No other part of the car is damaged.
I want to know whether my policy covers flood damage. Water entered the basement parking during heavy rain, but my car seems fine. Policy number POL-44019. No claim has occurred yet.

On 2026-10-22 my car MH43WX7788 hit a divider near Panvel. The vehicle cannot be driven and is blocking the road. No injuries. Police arrived but I don't know if an FIR was filed. Policy P-77410. Estimated damage Rs 95000.

Two incidents: On 2026-10-12 my car MH02YZ9900 had a broken side mirror in Malad, estimated Rs 4000. On 2026-10-26 the same car was hit by a truck in Goregaon and the truck driver was injured. Policy POL-77221. Please register the accident from 26 October. Police filed a report for the second incident.
My bike MH02AB7654 was stolen from outside my house in Kalyan on 2026-10-24. Policy number POL-2W-901. FIR filed at Kalyan police station. No one was hurt. Insured value is Rs 85000.

There was a small accident near Juhu on 2026-10-31. My car MH02CD1122 got scratched and the other car's door also got dented. Both drivers are okay, no injuries. Policy POL-55110. We exchanged details but no police report was filed. Estimated damage to my car Rs 18000.

Pls register claim. My car MH03EF4455 ka front glass crack ho gaya after a stone hit near BKC. Date 1 Nov 2026. Policy POL-66771. Only windshield damage, baki car bilkul thik hai. Approx 9,500 ka kharcha hai. No injuries.

Forwarded message: Customer says their parked car MH04GH7788 was hit by an unknown vehicle outside a mall in Borivali on 2026-10-19. The other vehicle left the scene. No injuries reported. Policy POL-88331. Damage estimate Rs 27000. Customer says police complaint was filed. Please process the motor claim.

I was driving MH12JK9090 near Lonavala on 2026-10-30 when the car skidded into a ditch. My passenger has a cut on the forehead and is being treated. Car is badly damaged but still starts and can be moved. Policy POL-12009. Repair estimate Rs 110000. Police report not filed yet.

My car MH01KL3333 was damaged in the floods at Kurla on 2026-10-21. Engine is completely seized and the surveyor says it is beyond repair. No injuries. Policy number POL-90909. Estimated loss INR 480000. No FIR was filed.
